regions.full_page: Joseph Walschon - 28 - T.B. of sholder-blade; supposed to be cured after carying cast on sholder for two years ..... Asked to what he attributed his cure to - he answered: "I came about two years ago and was urged to receive Holy Communion more frequently. After six months of daily Communion, finding myself decidedly improved and im- proving shortly after this venture for six months, I decided to con- tinue my daily Communions. Sick for about five years and unable to bless myself, except with my left hand ... I now feel that I am cured and can go back to work." In fact, he was sent for to take physical examination yesterday. However, having caught cold last Friday, he had temperature of 100 ... and was advised to get rid of cold and re- turn for exam. in two weeks ... for Board of Education.
